overview: 今日共收录61篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Laser‐Induced Rashba Spin‐Orbit Torques in Multiferroic Semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te
full_list.title_zh: 多铁性半导体 (Ge,Mn)Te 中激光诱导的 Rashba 自旋轨道扭矩
full_list.abstract: Advanced Science, EarlyView.
full_list.abstract_zh: 先进科学，早期观点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 先进科学，早期观点。
full_list.summary: 先进科学，早期观点。
full_list.journal: Wiley: Advanced Science: Table of Contents
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《多铁性半导体 (Ge,Mn)Te 中激光诱导的 Rashba 自旋轨道扭矩》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
full_list.title_zh: 通过量子霍尔铁磁体异质结的磁振子传输探测自旋顺序
full_list.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 29 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79281-3 Magnons in quantum Hall ferromagnets can be used as a very sensitive probe of magnetic order. Thus far, this technique has only been applied to single material systems. Here, Lee et al extend this to a heterostructure, using magnons generated in a monolayer of graphene to detect spin order in bilayer graphene.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子霍尔铁磁体中的磁振子可用作非常灵敏的磁序探针。到目前为止，该技术仅应用于单一材料系统。在这里，Lee 等人将其扩展到异质结构，使用单层石墨烯中产生的磁振子来检测双层石墨烯中的自旋顺序。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子霍尔铁磁体中的磁振子可用作非常灵敏的磁序探针。到目前为止，该技术仅应用于单一材料系统。在这里，Lee 等人将其扩展到异质结构，使用单层石墨烯中产生的磁振子来检测双层石墨烯中的自旋顺序。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.abstract: Author(s): P. Contreras-Gallardo, A. Kákay, and R. A. Gallardo Here, the authors reveal how curvature reshapes spin-wave dynamics and magnetic instabilities in synthetic antiferromagnetic nanotubes. The tubular geometry produces asymmetric mode localization and nonreciprocal propagation, while radial anisotropy drives a crossover from uniform softening to a finite-wave-vector instability. The latter signals the emergence of a stripe-like magnetic modulation along the nanotube axis. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 194430] Published Thu Oct 29, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者：P. Contreras-Gallardo、A. Kákay 和 R. A. Gallardo 在这里，作者揭示了曲率如何重塑合成反铁磁纳米管中的自旋波动力学和磁不稳定性。管状几何形状产生不对称模式定位和非互易传播，而径向各向异性驱动从均匀软化到有限波矢量不稳定性的交叉。后者标志着沿纳米管轴出现条纹状磁调制。 [物理。 Rev. B 114, 194430] 2026 年 10 月 29 日星期四发布

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《LaAlO 3 /KTaO 3 (111)界面超导中从类BEC到类BCS行为的交叉和顺磁迈斯纳效应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
full_list.abstract: We present a generalizable computational framework that combines a Kramers--Kronig transformation with a Drude free-carrier term to predict the optical and dielectric properties of substitutionally doped low-dimensional semiconductors. The framework is designed as a fast-screening alternative to full density functional theory (DFT) calculations, requiring only three physically transparent input parameters: the effective bandgap energy, the peak absorption energy, and the static dielectric constant. For metallic dopants, a Drude term is added with plasma frequency and scattering rate taken from optical fits of post-transition metals. The framework is validated against published first-principles DFT results for Al-, N-, and P-doped SiC nanotubes and against spectroscopic ellipsometry data for bulk 3C-SiC and 4H-SiC, showing good quantitative agreement. As a demonstration, we apply the framework to 15 dopant configurations of the pristine zigzag (8,0) silicon carbide nanotube (SiCNT), covering Group~III (B, Al, Ga, In, Tl), Group~V (N, P, As, Sb, Bi), and Group~VII (F, Cl, Br, I) elements. The framework captures the p-type to plasmonic transition in the Group~III series (absorption onset shifts from 2.0~eV to 1.0~eV), the monotonic bandgap narrowing in the Group~V series (sim3.7~eV for N to sim1.2~eV for Bi), and the systematic redshift in the halogen series (1.85~eV for pristine to 1.43 ± 0.20~eV for Cl). The framework provides a reproducible, computationally inexpensive route to optical property prediction for doped low-dimensional systems and yields quantitative guidelines for UV photodetectors, visible-range photocatalysts, infrared sensors, and broadband plasmonic devices. Complete Python source code, material parameter database, and figure generation scripts are provided for full reproducibility.

full_list.title_en: Assessing the Robustness of European and Chinese Air and High Speed Rail Network Accessibility
full_list.title_zh: 评估欧洲和中国空中和高速铁路网络可达性的稳健性
full_list.abstract: Aviation and High-speed rail (HSR) are primary modes for continental long-distance travel. While their integration can significantly enhance systemic robustness, network topologies and governance models differ drastically between Air and HSR networks across regions. We conduct a quantitative, comparative robustness analysis of the aviation-only network against the integrated aviation-HSR network for both Europe and China. Using a multi-layer network representation of scheduled services, topological metrics and a schedule-based routing algorithm, the networks are subjected to simulated random airport failures, adaptive targeted hub attacks, and operational airline shutdowns. The results reveal that under random failures, both unimodal aviation networks exhibit similar topological decay. However, under targeted attacks, China's reliance on a highly concentrated hub-and-spoke system leads to an earlier topological collapse compared to Europe's decentralized, point-to-point network. Crucially, integrating the HSR layer fundamentally shifts this dynamic. China's unified HSR mega-grid acts as a safeguard that nearly halves topological vulnerability and preserves substantial service availability during major aviation disruptions. Conversely, Europe's fragmented HSR ''patchwork" provides only marginal redundancy during aviation crises. While China can strategically leverage its HSR grid to mitigate disruptions in the aviation network, Europe must prioritize cross-border rail services to create a viable multimodal safety net for long-distance travel.
full_list.abstract_zh: 航空和高速铁路（ HSR ）是大陆长途旅行的主要模式。虽然它们的集成可以显着增强系统稳健性，但Air和HSR网络之间的网络拓扑和治理模型在各个地区之间存在巨大差异。我们对照欧洲和中国的综合航空高铁网络，对纯航空网络进行定量、比较稳健性分析。使用调度服务的多层网络表示、拓扑度量和基于调度的路由算法，网络将受到模拟随机机场故障、自适应定向枢纽攻击和航空公司运营关闭的影响。结果表明，在随机故障下，两个单峰航空网络都表现出相似的拓扑衰减。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 航空和高速铁路（ HSR ）是大陆长途旅行的主要模式。虽然它们的集成可以显着增强系统稳健性，但Air和HSR网络之间的网络拓扑和治理模型在各个地区之间存在巨大差异。我们对照欧洲和中国的综合航空高铁网络，对纯航空网络进行定量、比较稳健性分析。使用调度服务的多层网络表示、拓扑度量和基于调度的路由算法，网络将受到模拟随机机场故障、自适应定向枢纽攻击和航空公司运营关闭的影响。结果表明，在随机故障下，两个单峰航空网络都表现出相似的拓扑衰减。然而，在有针对性的攻击下，与欧洲分散的点对点网络相比，中国对高度集中的中心辐射系统的依赖导致了更早的拓扑崩溃。至关重要的是，整合HSR层从根本上改变了这种动态。中国统一的高铁大型电网起到了保障作用，几乎将拓扑脆弱性降低了一半，并在重大航空中断期间保持了大量的服务可用性。相反，欧洲零散的高铁“拼凑”在航空危机期间只能提供边际冗余。虽然中国可以战略性地利用其高铁网络来缓解航空网络的中断，但欧洲必须优先考虑跨境铁路服务，以创建可行的多式联运长途旅行安全网。

full_list.title_en: Evaluation of a GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against global space-weather indices during the May 2024 geomagnetic storm
full_list.title_zh: 2024年5月地磁风暴期间全球导航卫星系统衍生的RTK-RISK指标与全球空间天气指数的评估
full_list.abstract: Severe space-weather events can produce rapid temporal and spatial ionospheric disturbances that degrade high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning. This study evaluates a regional GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against independent global space-weather and geomagnetic indices during the extreme geomagnetic storm of 11 May 2024. RTK-RISK combines regional Rate of Total Electron Content Index (ROTI) variability and spatial vertical total electron content (VTEC) gradients derived from a Latvian continuously operating reference station network. The indicator and its individual components were compared with the geomagnetic Dst and Kp indices, the interplanetary magnetic field Bz component, its southward component Bs, solar-wind speed, and the coupling proxy VswBs. Spearman rank correlation was used as the principal measure of association. The strongest statistically significant simultaneous relationship with RTK-RISK was observed for Dst (ρ = −0.63). Kp showed a positive association of ρ = 0.65, although this relationship did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.078, N = 8) at its native 3-h resolution. Significant simultaneous associations were also observed for Bs (ρ = 0.41), Bz (ρ = −0.40), and VswBs (ρ = 0.35). The signs of these relationships were physically consistent with enhanced geomagnetic activity and southward interplanetary magnetic field conditions. The results indicate that the independently derived regional RTK-RISK indicator responds coherently to global space-weather conditions and provides a locally resolved measure of ionospheric disturbance relevant to RTK positioning reliability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 严重的空间天气事件会产生快速的时间和空间电离层干扰，从而降低高精度全球导航卫星系统（ GNSS ）的定位。本研究根据2024年5月11日极端地磁风暴期间独立的全球空间天气和地磁指数，对区域GNSS衍生的RTK-RISK指标进行评估。RTK-RISK结合了来自拉脱维亚连续运行参考站网络的区域总电子含量指数（ ROTI ）变异率和空间垂直总电子含量（ VTEC ）梯度。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《2024年5月地磁风暴期间全球导航卫星系统衍生的RTK-RISK指标与全球空间天气指数的评估》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Impact of Fractal Dimension on Antenna Behavior: Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake Designs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Impact of Fractal Dimension on Antenna Behavior: Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake Designs
full_list.abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of two fractal antennas—the Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake-designed with identical dimensions and operating at 2.3~GHz. Although similar in size, their different fractal geometries lead to distinct electromagnetic behaviors. Key performance metrics such as input impedance, reflection coefficient, and radiation patterns are analyzed.

full_list.title_en: The Lunar Stairway: An Orbital-Platform-First Paradigm for Lunar Development and Its Engineering Rationale
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The Lunar Stairway: An Orbital-Platform-First Paradigm for Lunar Development and Its Engineering Rationale
full_list.abstract: Objective: To examine the mainstream premise that lunar development must be based on the lunar surface; to argue the engineering rationale for building long-term residential bases, production facilities, and logistics hubs first in circumlunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface; and to propose a system design for the “Lunar Stairway” (a distributed system of circumlunar platform ports).  Methods: On the basis of orbital mechanics (the vis-viva equation and the rocket equation), the velocity increments and mass penalties of lunar-surface landing and departure were calculated and compared with those of residence in circumlunar orbit; the success rate of lunar soft-landing missions worldwide from 1966 to 2025 was tallied; scientific assessments of the Apollo moonquake network, the Chang’e-4 in situ radiation measurements on the lunar surface, and the health effects of lunar dust were compiled; and a ballistic delivery and interception–deceleration model for the “circumlunar platform–capsule projectile–cable-net/pit/sponge-lake splashdown” system was established.  Results: A one-way landing on the lunar surface requires a velocity increment of approximately 1.9 km/s (with Isp = 300 s, propellant accounts for approximately 47.6% of the initial mass), and departure from the Moon requires a further approximately 1.85 km/s. The fully successful lunar soft-landing rate is approximately 50%, with failures concentrated in the powered-descent phase. Apollo seismometers recorded shallow moonquakes of magnitude up to approximately 5, lasting from tens of minutes to several hours, far longer than the tens of seconds of terrestrial earthquakes. The dose equivalent rate on the lunar surface is approximately 1.4 mSv/d (twice that on the International Space Station), and an extreme solar particle event of the 1972 type could deliver a dose of the order of 3–4 Sv without shielding. Lunar dust is fine, electrically charged, and sharp-edged; it is difficult to remove completely and causes irreversible damage to equipment and to the human respiratory system. With frozen orbits, the annual station-keeping velocity increment in low lunar orbit can be held to 10–50 m/s, corresponding to approximately 3–17 kg/(t·yr) of chemical propellant or approximately 0.6–3.2 kg/(t·yr) with electric propulsion, comparable to or lower than the ISS reboost level (approximately 18 kg/(t·yr)); ballistic delivery requires only an ejection increment of approximately 23 m/s and approximately 10 kg/t of propellant. Near-lunar orbits, although they require more orbit control, maintain closer contact with the lunar surface and receive less galactic radiation because of blockage by the Moon. Different orbits and distributed deployments should therefore be adopted according to actual requirements.  Conclusions: Circumlunar-orbit platforms are comprehensively superior to lunar-surface residence in energy, safety, environment, astronomical observation, and logistics efficiency. It is recommended that the primary construction layer of lunar development be placed in lunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface, and that low-overload ballistic delivery and electromagnetic ejection be used to open a “lunar orbit–lunar surface” materials corridor (without which construction of the Stairway would be pointless). If a momentum-exchange mode is adopted between platform and cargo, substantial propellant and energy can be saved, coupling the efficient descent of cargo with platform orbit changes and orbit maintenance. The paper also proposes that spent spacecraft hulls be stored in lunar orbit as a reserve of scarce metals.

full_list.title_en: Ultrathin metal layer boosts spin-related signals, opening a door to ultralow-power electronics
full_list.title_zh: 超薄金属层增强了自旋相关信号，为超低功耗电子产品打开了大门
full_list.abstract: Researchers at Kyushu University have found that an ultrathin layer of iridium manganese (IrMn) can improve two spin-related signals in a structure made of a magnetic insulator and a platinum film. By examining how spin currents are generated and absorbed, the team gained insights into how the intermediate layer improves spin transfer. The findings could inform the development of ultralow-power devices for computing and energy harvesting.
full_list.abstract_zh: 九州大学的研究人员发现，超薄的铱锰（IrMn）层可以改善由磁绝缘体和铂薄膜制成的结构中的两个自旋相关信号。通过研究自旋电流是如何产生和吸收的，研究小组深入了解了中间层如何改善自旋转移。这些发现可以为用于计算和能量收集的超低功耗设备的开发提供信息。

full_list.title_en: Structural, Dielectric, Optical, and Electrochemical Insights into Enhanced OER Activity of Y3Fe5O12 over YFeO3 Ferrite Nanoparticles for Hydroelectric Cell Applications
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Structural, Dielectric, Optical, and Electrochemical Insights into Enhanced OER Activity of Y3Fe5O12 over YFeO3 Ferrite Nanoparticles for Hydroelectric Cell Applications
full_list.abstract: YFeO3 (YF) and Y3Fe5O12 (YGF) nanoparticles were synthesized by a modified low-temperature sol-gel auto-combustion route to elucidate structure–property relationships governing oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and hydroelectric cell (HEC) performance. Rietveld-refined XRD confirmed orthorhombic YF and cubic garnet YGF phases, while Raman and HRTEM established phase purity, crystallinity, and morphology. YGF exhibited higher dielectric permittivity (23.20), lower dielectric loss (0.765), larger specific surface area (12.815 m2g− 1), and oxygen-vacancy-rich surface chemistry, facilitating electrochemical charge transfer. Accordingly, YGF showed higher ECSA (18.25 cm²), Cdl (0.73 mF cm− 2), and lower Rct (359 Ω) than YF. YGF delivered superior OER activity with an overpotential of 392 mV at 10 mA cm− 2 and a Tafel slope of 133 mV dec− 1. The YGF-based HEC achieved 14.123 mA short-circuit current, 0.981 V open-circuit voltage, and 13.854 mW maximum power, demonstrating its potential for sustainable hydroelectric energy conversion. These findings establish YGF as a promising multifunctional energy-conversion material.

full_list.title_en: Comparative Analysis of Viscoelastic Models for Head-Tissue Layers under Step Loading
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Comparative Analysis of Viscoelastic Models for Head-Tissue Layers under Step Loading
full_list.abstract: This study compares four linear viscoelastic networks for scalp, skull, cerebrospinal fluid, and brain contributions. An eight-element parallel network describes stress relaxation, while an eight-element series network describes creep. Reduced Maxwell and Kelvin models are evaluated alongside these configurations. Closed-form equations connect the spring–dashpot arrangements to their response curves. Under a 5% step strain, the parallel network relaxes from 400.835 to 400.334 MPa, a decrease of about 0.125%. The skull spring accounts for most of the stress. At a held stress of 24.010 kPa, the series network approaches a strain rate of 4802.05 s−1 because its free dashpots sustain flow. The reduced Kelvin network gives bounded creep with a 7 ms time constant. Its strain reaches 14.6224 at 0.1 s, exceeding the small-strain range at the selected load. The three-element Maxwell approximation closely follows the total relaxation stress, with a maximum difference of 0.015082 MPa. Comparison of the normalized relaxing components reveals the difference in decay rates. The findings connect network structure, material inputs, and loading to the resulting relaxation and creep behavior, providing a basis for further development of reduced head-tissue models.

full_list.title_en: Hydrogen-bond dynamics, proton transfer, and water mobility in crystalline guanidinium carbonates for direct air capture
full_list.title_zh: 用于直接空气捕获的结晶碳酸胍中的氢键动力学、质子转移和水迁移率
full_list.abstract: Direct air capture requires sorbents that bind CO2 selectively yet release it with low energy. Bis-iminoguanidines capture CO2 by crystallizing as hydrated carbonate salts, but the molecular events linking water loss, proton transfer, and CO2 release remain unresolved. Here we combine variable-temperature single-crystal neutron and X-ray diffraction with ab initio molecular dynamics to determine how two crystalline carbonate phases follow different regeneration pathways. We show that lattice water acts as a molecular gate for carbonate protonation. In a metastable phase, water is isolated from carbonate, creating a softer hydrogen-bond network that promotes surface proton transfer and a transient carbonic-acid configuration. In the stable phase, water hydrogen-bonds directly to carbonate, stabilizing the lattice and suppressing proton transfer until water rearrangement and partial desorption disrupt the hydration environment. Controlling hydration topology together with targeted hydrogen-bond flexibility offers a route to direct-air-capture sorbents that retain selective CO2 binding while lowering regeneration energy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 直接空气捕获需要吸附剂选择性地结合二氧化碳，但以低能量释放二氧化碳。双亚氨基胍通过结晶为水合碳酸盐来捕获二氧化碳，但与水损失、质子转移和二氧化碳释放相关的分子事件仍未解决。在这里，我们将变温单晶中子和X射线衍射与从头分子动力学相结合，以确定两种结晶碳酸盐相如何遵循不同的再生途径。我们证明了晶格水充当碳酸盐质子的分子门。在亚稳相中，水与碳酸盐分离，形成更软的氢键网络，促进表面质子转移和瞬态碳酸结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 直接空气捕获需要吸附剂选择性地结合二氧化碳，但以低能量释放二氧化碳。双亚氨基胍通过结晶为水合碳酸盐来捕获二氧化碳，但与水损失、质子转移和二氧化碳释放相关的分子事件仍未解决。在这里，我们将变温单晶中子和X射线衍射与从头分子动力学相结合，以确定两种结晶碳酸盐相如何遵循不同的再生途径。我们证明了晶格水充当碳酸盐质子的分子门。在亚稳相中，水与碳酸盐分离，形成更软的氢键网络，促进表面质子转移和瞬态碳酸结构。在稳定相中，水氢直接与碳酸盐结合，稳定晶格并抑制质子转移，直到水重排和部分解吸破坏水合环境。控制水合拓扑和有针对性的氢键灵活性为直接空气捕获吸附剂提供了一种途径，该吸附剂在降低再生能量的同时保留了选择性的二氧化碳结合。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Decision Framework with Golden Cut and ARTASI for Sustainable Mining Method Selection in Geologically Complex Thin Seams
full_list.title_zh: 具有Golden Cut和ARTASI的量子球面模糊决策框架，用于地质复杂薄煤层的可持续开采方法选择
full_list.abstract: The selection of a suitable mining method for geologically complex and thin coal seams, particularly those with thicknesses ranging from 0.30 to 2.12 m, remains a critical challenge. In Meghalaya, this issue is of paramount importance, as conventional unscientific extraction practices have been associated with safety hazards, resource losses, and environmental degradation. This study proposes a Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Large-Scale Decision-Making (QSF-LSDM) framework to support the systematic selection of mining methods under uncertain and conflicting conditions. The framework employs Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Sets (QSFS) to represent vagueness and hesitation in expert judgments through membership, non-membership, and hesitancy amplitudes with associated phase information. To reduce subjectivity in fuzzy parameter selection, a Golden Cut procedure based on the Golden Ratio is incorporated. Expert importance is determined using Consensus-Based Expert Weighting (CBEW), which reflects the degree of agreement among experts. Their assessments are subsequently aggregated using the Quantum Spherical Fuzzy Weighted Bonferroni Mean (QSFWBM), which captures interactions among criteria. Objective criterion weights are obtained through continuous Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), formulated to maximize the overall pairwise score deviation among alternatives. The final ranking is established using the Alternative Ranking Technique based on Adaptive Standardized Intervals (ARTASI). The framework is applied to 12 candidate mining methods evaluated across 12 criteria covering technical, economic, safety, environmental, and operational aspects.. The results identify automated 3D-trajectory shearer mining ((:M₁₀); (:Ω:=0.674)) as the highest-ranked method, followed by shearer-based thin-seam longwall mining ((:M₅); (:Ω:=0.662)) and continuous-miner bord-and-pillar mining ((:M₃); (:Ω:=0.632)). Sensitivity and comparative analyses further demonstrate the stability and robustness of the obtained ranking.

full_list.title_en: Regulation, function and evolutionary structure of St18, encoding a Zinc-Finger Transcription Factor, in the oligodendrocyte lineage
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Regulation, function and evolutionary structure of St18, encoding a Zinc-Finger Transcription Factor, in the oligodendrocyte lineage
full_list.abstract: Myelinating oligodendrocytes are first observed during evolution in vertebrates above jawless fishes. Oligodendrocyte progenitor cells (OPCs) undergo extensive transcriptional and morphological remodelling to initiate differentiation and myelination. We report that the zinc-finger transcription factor St18 (aka Myt3) is upregulated during the OPC-to–newly formed oligodendrocyte (NFOL) transition. Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) performed after lysolecithin-induced demyelination of the mouse spinal cord revealed that St18 was acutely upregulated in remyelinating OPCs. In primary rat OPC cultures, St18 overexpression promoted differentiation, whereas OPC conditional St18 knockout delayed developmental myelination in the mouse brain. Chromatin accessibility profiling identified candidate cis-regulatory elements for oligodendroglial St18 expression activated by core oligodendrocyte transcription factors, including SOX10, KLF9/13, and MYRF, and we confirmed that St18 expression in OPCs is Sox10-dependent in vivo. Phylogenetic analysis suggests that St18 arose via duplication of Myt1 in early jawed vertebrates, coinciding with the emergence of myelinating oligodendrocytes. These findings define St18 as a transcriptional marker of NFOLs and OLs and provide insight into the evolutionary regulation of central nervous system myelination.

full_list.title_en: Lattice-oxygen topology engineering to enable durable and high-efficiency aqueous manganese batteries
full_list.title_zh: 晶格-氧拓扑工程可实现耐用且高效的水系锰电池
full_list.abstract: Aqueous manganese batteries based on MnO2 electrodeposition-dissolution process offer a compelling route to safe, low-cost and scalable energy storage. Despite their merits of high specific capacity and voltage, the hindrance towards practical implementation is the parasitic reaction and accumulation of dead manganese, leading to poor reversibility and low energy efficiency. Here, we identify the lattice-oxygen topology as the structural origin of Mn3+-driven parasitic reaction during weakly acidic MnO2 dissolution. By synthesizing a series of MnO2 polymorphs with a controllable transition from pyramidal (Opy) to planar oxygen (Opl) topology, we reveal that the rapid Opy dissolution accounts for the formation of MnOOH intermediates (i.e., Mn3+), but MnOOH is suppressed on Opl-dominated pathways owing to the larger lattice distortion. Guided by this mechanism, a facile and cost-effective approach is applied to realize dual-regulation of oxygen topology, namely, activating Opl dissolution and simultaneously passivating Opy sites through strengthened Mn-O bonding. As a result of the suppressed Mn3+ disproportionation side reaction, the Mn-Cu cell retains 100% capacity over 5800 cycles with an energy efficiency of 83% and Coulombic efficiency close to 99.99%. This study unlocks the potential of aqueous manganese oxide batteries for highly durable and sustainable energy storage.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于MnO2电沉积溶解过程的水性锰电池为安全、低成本和可扩展的能源存储提供了一条引人注目的途径。尽管它们具有高比容量和高电压的优点，但实际应用的障碍是寄生反应和死锰的积累，导致可逆性差和能量效率低。在这里，我们将晶格-氧拓扑结构确定为弱酸性 MnO2 溶解过程中 Mn3+ 驱动的寄生反应的结构起源。

full_list.title_en: Mechanistic Study on the Filtration Behavior Simulation of Suspended Solids in Mine Water by Coal Mine Goaf
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Mechanistic Study on the Filtration Behavior Simulation of Suspended Solids in Mine Water by Coal Mine Goaf
full_list.abstract: Coal and water resources are inversely distributed in western China, and the resource utilization of mine water is recognized as one of the key pathways for the green development of coal. In underground coal mine reservoirs, gangue from mined-out areas is utilized as the core purification medium; however, the removal characteristics and synergistic mechanisms for suspended solids are not yet fully clarified.Gangue and suspended solids from the Daliuta mining area are selected as research subjects. Dynamic circulation simulation tests, XRD, SEM, and laser particle size analysis are employed to systematically investigate the purification effects of gangue on suspended solids in mine water under varying concentrations, settling times, settling heights, and settling distances, and the underlying mechanisms are elucidated.The turbidity of mine water is reduced from 77.43 NTU to 11.41 NTU by gangue, with a total removal rate of 85.26%, which is nearly 20 percentage points higher than that of natural sedimentation. A higher initial concentration of suspended solids results in a faster initial removal rate, and 750 mg/L is identified as the optimal purification concentration. The main removal process is completed within 15 minutes, and an increase in settling height significantly enhances the purification effect. Suspended solids are removed through the synergistic actions of physical interception, gravitational sedimentation, and surface adsorption by gangue. Coarse particles of 150–180 µm are effectively intercepted, while most residual particles are smaller than 60 µm.The regulatory patterns of gangue particle size gradation, hydraulic retention time, and settling conditions on suspended solids sedimentation efficiency are clarified. A theoretical basis and technical support are thereby provided for the structural optimization of mined-out areas in underground coal mine reservoirs and the in-situ, low-cost purification of mine water.

full_list.title_en: Synthesis and Structural Characterization of Some D-panthenol Cocrystals using Carboxylic acid as Coformers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Synthesis and Structural Characterization of Some D-panthenol Cocrystals using Carboxylic acid as Coformers
full_list.abstract: D-Panthenol (provitamin B5) is a pharmaceutically and cosmetically important active ingredient whose solid-state application is constrained by pronounced hygroscopicity and limited crystallinity. In this study, cocrystals of D-panthenol were designed and synthesized with three carboxylic acid coformers oxalic acid, isophthalic acid (2:1), and trimesic acid via slow solvent evaporation from methanol/ethanol solution, and the resulting solid forms were characterized by UV–Visible and Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. UV–Visible spectroscopy revealed a consistent bathochromic (red) shift in the absorption maximum (λmax), rising from 210 nm in pure D-panthenol to 214 nm in the oxalic acid cocrystal (Dp–OX), 217 nm in the isophthalic acid cocrystal (Dp–ISO, 2:1), and 222 nm in the trimesic acid cocrystal (Dp–Trim). The magnitude of the shift scaled with coformer aromaticity and hydrogen-bonding capacity, and the aromatic coformers additionally introduced secondary absorption bands at 244, 273, and 302 nm (Dp–ISO) and 258, 283, and 320 nm (Dp–Trim), consistent with supplementary π→π* transitions. These electronic changes were corroborated by FTIR spectroscopy, which showed systematic shifts in the O–H stretch (3454–3464 cm⁻¹), C = O stretch (1737–1741 cm⁻¹), N–H/C = C bend (1637–1641 cm⁻¹), and C–O stretch (1111–1127 cm⁻¹) regions relative to pure D-panthenol. Because no new absorption bands emerged in any spectrum, the observed shifts are attributed to intermolecular hydrogen bonding rather than covalent modification, confirming that D-panthenol's molecular identity was preserved in all three cocrystals. Together, the UV–Visible and FTIR results provide convergent spectroscopic evidence that cocrystallization with carboxylic acid coformers systematically perturbs the electronic and vibrational environment of D-panthenol through non-covalent supramolecular interactions, supporting cocrystal engineering as a viable route to modified D-panthenol solid forms for pharmaceutical application.

full_list.title_en: Effect of HIP and Laser Shock Peening Sequence on the Fatigue Behavior of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti6Al4V
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Effect of HIP and Laser Shock Peening Sequence on the Fatigue Behavior of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti6Al4V
full_list.abstract: The fatigue performance of laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V is influenced by process-induced defects, surface condition and the stress state generated by manufacturing and post-processing. This study examined whether reversing the order of hot isostatic pressing (HIP) and laser shock peening (LSP) altered the fatigue response of a deliberately defect-rich LPBF condition. Specimens were subjected to LSP followed by HIP or HIP followed by LSP. X-ray computed tomography was used to quantify the internal defect populations, stress-life testing was conducted between 210 and 380 MPa at R = 0 and 50 Hz, and scanning electron microscopy was used to examine post-test surface features associated with crack initiation. The two hybrid routes exhibited similar defect counts and mean sphericity values, while the HIP + LSP condition contained the largest measured defect and the greatest detected defect volume. Nevertheless, HIP + LSP produced the stronger fatigue response, including two right-censored run-outs at 106 cycles, compared with no run-outs for LSP + HIP. The CT descriptors therefore did not account for the observed sequence effect. The results are consistent with, but do not directly prove, the hypothesis that applying LSP after HIP preserves the beneficial final surface state generated by peening, whereas subsequent HIP exposure may modify or relax part of that state. Because residual stress was not measured, this mechanism is presented as a literature-supported interpretation rather than a measured causal relationship. The findings demonstrate that post-processing order can influence fatigue performance even when conventional CT defect metrics do not indicate a superior internal defect population.

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Token Optimization for Text-to-Image Person Re-identification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Hybrid Token Optimization for Text-to-Image Person Re-identification
full_list.abstract: Text-to-image person re-identification (TIReID) enables natural-language search over pedestrian image collections. Although dual-grained methods combine global and local matching, recent dual-grained pipelines use encoder-produced global tokens for coarse matching and attention-ranked local tokens for fine-grained matching. This interface leaves global representations without complementary priors, local evidence dependent on a single ranking cue, and image--text sequence asymmetry insufficiently addressed. To address these limitations, we propose Hybrid Token Optimization (HTO), a parameter-efficient, role-aware framework at the encoder--matcher interface. HTO comprises two coordinated components. Dictionary Prior Enhancement uses modality-specific dictionaries, cross-attention, and conservative residual blending to refine global-token representations. Spatial-Energy Heterogeneous Token Selection combines attention-based saliency, a feature-norm cue, and an adaptive minimum-coverage constraint to broaden local-token coverage in both modalities. Both components leave the established matching heads unchanged and operate during both training and inference, while the auxiliary losses are used only for training. Under a fixed-seed protocol, HTO yields Rank-1 point-estimate gains of 0.45, 0.40, and 2.25 percentage points over the reproduced baseline on CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, and RSTPReid, respectively. It increases the parameter count by less than 0.4% and is also compatible with Test-Time Human-Centered Interaction. These results suggest that role-aware token-interface refinement can improve fine-grained cross-modal retrieval without redesigning the matcher.

full_list.title_en: Hydrological Drought Risk Assessment and Management Prioritization under Changing Climate: Part 1. Scenario-Neutral Assessment of Bivariate Drought Hazard
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Hydrological Drought Risk Assessment and Management Prioritization under Changing Climate: Part 1. Scenario-Neutral Assessment of Bivariate Drought Hazard
full_list.abstract: The results of a climate change impact assessment can differ substantially depending on the choice of climate change scenario and climate model. This study introduced a scenario-neutral approach that does not depend on specific future projections and evaluated the hydrological drought hazard of the 113 middle-sized watersheds of South Korea across a precipitation-temperature exposure space defined by systematic perturbations in precipitation and temperature. The design drought return period was estimated by copula-based bivariate frequency analysis of drought duration and severity applied to the simulated daily streamflow for 1974–2025, and watershed-specific response surfaces were constructed from 252 precipitation-temperature perturbation combinations ((:R²)=0.568–0.932). Local sensitivity analysis around the baseline point showed that the return period increased with increasing precipitation and decreased with rising temperature, and the national median precipitation increase required to offset 1℃ of warming was 2.64%. When the 72 projections from 18 general circulation models (GCMs) under 4 Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP) scenarios were mapped onto the response surfaces, the ensemble median showed an increase in the return period for all SSP-period combinations, whereas 13.5–31.3% of the individual projections showed a decrease, identifying unfavorable projections that run counter to the central tendency. These results show that the scenario-neutral response surfaces allow changes in drought hazard under diverse future projections to be compared on a consistent basis, and they provide the hazard information for the watershed-level management prioritization.

full_list.title_en: Interoceptive Breathing Perceptions with Anxiety
full_list.title_zh: 焦虑时的感知呼吸感知
full_list.abstract: Background Interoception (i.e. the sensing, processing, and evaluation of signals originating from within the body) has emerged as a key process linked to anxiety, sharing both neural and physiological substrates. The current project examined how anxiety is related to subjective measures of sensitivity towards two different interoceptive breathing modalities, inspiratory resistance and hypercapnia (elevated carbon dioxide; CO2), across a spectrum of anxiety levels.Methods Participants (n = 75) completed self-report measures of anxiety and related variables before undergoing two breathing perception tasks involving graded increases in inspiratory resistance (10, 20, 30 cmH2O/L/s) and hypercapnia (2%, 4%, 6% CO2). Perceptual responses (sensory via breathlessness ratings and affect via anxiety ratings) at each step were recorded using visual analogue scales. Data were analysed in STATA using linear mixed effects regression models to assess the variance associated with anxiety status, stimulus level, and their interaction. Additional exploratory correlation analyses were also performed between the perceptual, physiological and anxiety-related measures.Results Primary analyses indicated that anxiety was associated with increased overall affective ratings (resistance: β = 3.83, p < 0.05; CO2: β = 3.28, p < 0.05) but not sensory ratings. However, anxiety did not influence participants’ sensitivity to changes in stimulus intensity (i.e. slope) for either inspiratory resistance or hypercapnia. Additionally, anxiety did not relate to ventilatory responses during either stimulus. Exploratory analyses revealed additional correlations including lower self-efficacy relating to altered ventilation during both tasks.Conclusions Overall, these findings suggest that anxiety is primarily associated with increased overall affective perceptions of breathing-related interoceptive signals but does not alter the sensory ratings nor ventilatory responses. This dissociation highlights potential markers for anxiety vulnerability and may inform the development of targeted interventions that focus on specifically modifying affective responses to bodily sensations.

full_list.title_en: Isogeometric thermal buckling analysis of variable-stiffness laminated plates with delamination using a multi-point constraint approach
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Isogeometric thermal buckling analysis of variable-stiffness laminated plates with delamination using a multi-point constraint approach
full_list.abstract: Variable-stiffness laminated plates offer superior structural efficiency but are susceptible to delamination defects that significantly degrade their thermal buckling performance. This paper presents an isogeometric analysis (IGA) framework for the thermal buckling of VS laminated plates containing elliptical or rectangular delamination. The geometry and displacement field are discretized using non-uniform rational B-splines, which naturally satisfy the high-order continuity required by higher-order shear deformation theory and accurately represent curvilinear fiber paths. Delamination is modeled by a two-plate approach, dividing the plate into upper and lower sublaminates in the delaminated region. Multi-point constraints (MPCs) enforced via a penalty method are employed to guarantee kinematic compatibility along the intact interface. Fully clamped boundary conditions are applied on all four edges. The thermal buckling problem is reduced to a generalized eigenvalue problem, and the critical temperature is obtained as the smallest positive eigenvalue. Numerical verification against FEM results confirms the accuracy of the proposed model. Parametric studies investigate the effects of delamination shape, size, aspect ratio, in-plane location, and number of delaminations on the critical thermal buckling temperature. The proposed IGA-MPC framework provides an accurate and efficient tool for analyzing the thermal buckling of VS laminated plates with delamination.

full_list.title_en: Latitudinal contrast in the equatorial Atlantic influence on Nigerian August rainfall
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Latitudinal contrast in the equatorial Atlantic influence on Nigerian August rainfall
full_list.abstract: The influence of the equatorial Atlantic on West African monsoon rainfall is well established for the region as a whole, but its variation with latitude and month within Nigeria has not been quantified. Satellite rainfall estimates and sea-surface temperatures for 1981 to 2025 were used to compare a southern (4 to 8°N) and a northern (10 to 14°N) band after removing El Niño–Southern Oscillation and linear-trend effects. In a pre-specified analysis of June to August rainfall, one standard deviation of warming in an equatorial Atlantic temperature index (ATL3) was associated with 56.5 mm more rainfall in the south and 3.2 mm in the north, a difference of 53.3 mm (95% interval 19.5 to 87.1 mm). An exploratory monthly analysis located the contrast in August, the month of the southern little dry season (49.0 mm; 26.2 to 68.7 mm), and it was confirmed in an independent period, 1951 to 1980, with rain-gauge data and criteria fixed beforehand (35.9 mm; 20.0 to 52.2 mm). The August contrast persisted when the datasets, band definitions, linear trend and other ocean basins were changed. It corresponded to 12 to 23% of local rainfall south of 8.5°N and fell to near zero north of 10°N, and reanalysis data showed stronger moisture convergence over the southern band. The full-season contrast was less robust, and May temperatures gave no forecast skill. The signal of an ocean basin can therefore differ markedly within one country and one month, which region-wide seasonal indices conceal.

full_list.title_en: Life cycle assessment of the Garissa solar PV plant: evaluating the environmental sustainability of utility-scale solar in Kenya
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Life cycle assessment of the Garissa solar PV plant: evaluating the environmental sustainability of utility-scale solar in Kenya
full_list.abstract: Kenya’s transition to low-carbon energy systems has accelerated the deployment of utility-scale solar photovoltaic projects, yet questions remain about their long-term environmental sustainability. This study presents a cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment of the Garissa Solar PV Plant, the largest grid-connected solar facility in East and Central Africa, to quantify its greenhouse gas emissions and identify environmental hotspots. Using an attributional LCA framework and a custom Excel-based model and region appropriate inventories, the study assessed emissions across manufacturing, transportation, operation, and end-of-life management under current national conditions. The results indicate the plant’s lifecycle intensity is 23.6 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹, substantially lower than fossil-based electricity generation (coal: 780–1095 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; natural gas: 400–726 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹), and consistent with international benchmarks for utility-scale PV systems (typically 20–60 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹, depending on the technology, geography, and system boundaries). Lifecycle contributions are dominated by upstream stages: manufacturing, 17.27 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹ and balance of components, 5.85 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; transport, 0.47 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹; and end-of-life, 0.0237 g CO₂-eq kWh⁻¹ under a conservative 100% landfill baseline. Although Garissa’s carbon profile aligns with international benchmarks, it reveals Kenya’s reliance on carbon-intensive global supply chains remains a key driver in upstream emissions. The study underscores the need for lifecycle-aligned policy reforms, including solar-specific recycling protocols, localised manufacturing strategies, and water-efficient maintenance practices in arid regions. It also anticipates future challenges posed by BESS, which could significantly increase lifecycle emissions. By providing Kenya’s first utility-scale solar LCA, this research offers critical insights for policymakers, developers, and researchers aiming to align solar expansion with climate and sustainability goals.

full_list.title_en: Merging nonlinear finite element models and the floating frame of reference formulation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Merging nonlinear finite element models and the floating frame of reference formulation
full_list.abstract: The current state of the art floating frame of reference formulation is used for flexible multibody dynamics simulations. In this formulation, the flexibility is modelled using linear finite element models with respect to a moving frame. Nevertheless, taking into account higher order terms locally can be important for the purpose of modelling moderate to large strains within a body. Nonlinear finite element models contain such terms. In this work, it is explained how the floating frame of reference formulation and the nonlinear finite element formulation can be merged to obtain the best of both worlds. A new nonlinear finite element formulation is developed relative to a body’s floating frame. This is used to find expressions for the internal elastic loads and tangent stiffness matrix. Both expressions contain all possible higher order terms and can be used in the incremental solution procedures for static and dynamic simulations. The new formulation is developed such that when these higher order terms are neglected, a floating frame formulation is obtained in terms of the absolute interface coordinates. Hence, this work enables inclusion of carefully selected higher order terms in the floating frame formulation for specific applications. In this way, the floating frame of reference formulation allows for higher order terms while at the same time model order reduction techniques can still be applied.

full_list.title_en: Microstructural and Strength Characterization of Acid-Resistant Cement Mortar Incorporating Crab Shell Powder and Recycled PET
full_list.title_zh: 蟹壳粉和再生PET耐酸水泥砂浆的显微组织和强度表征
full_list.abstract: Environmental pollution caused by marine shell waste and plastic disposal, together with carbon dioxide emissions from cement production, has increased the demand for sustainable construction materials. This study investigates the microstructural characteristics and acid resistance of cement mortar incorporating crab shell powder (CSP) as a partial cement replacement and recycled polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic as a fine aggregate replacement. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis identified portlandite, quartz, belite, and tobermorite phases, providing insights into hydration and microstructural development. X-ray fluorescence (XRF) analysis revealed slight variations in the major oxide composition and clinker compounds, supporting the potential use of CSP as a supplementary cementitious material. Durability performance was evaluated by immersing mortar cubes in hydrochloric acid (HCl) and sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) for 56 and 92 days. Weight loss and compressive strength were assessed to determine the effects of CSP and PET replacement levels. The results indicate that moderate CSP incorporation improves acid resistance and durability, whereas excessive replacement causes deterioration of the cementitious matrix. A CSP replacement level of up to 15% by weight of cement is identified as a promising option for sustainable mortar production. This approach offers potential benefits through waste valorization and reduced reliance on conventional cement and natural fine aggregates.
full_list.abstract_zh: 海洋贝壳废弃物和塑料处理造成的环境污染，加上水泥生产产生的二氧化碳排放，增加了对可持续建筑材料的需求。本研究研究了以蟹壳粉（ CSP ）作为部分水泥替代品，再生聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（ PET ）塑料作为精细骨料替代品的水泥砂浆的微观结构特征和耐酸性。X射线衍射（ XRD ）分析确定了钙质岩、石英、贝氏体和托氏体相，为水合作用和微观结构发展提供了见解。X射线荧光（ XRF ）分析显示主要氧化物成分和熟料化合物的轻微变化，支持CSP作为辅助胶凝材料的潜在用途。

full_list.title_en: Multi-Objective Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization of Lightweight Structures for Structural Stiffness, Thermal Performance, and Dynamic Characteristics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Multi-Objective Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization of Lightweight Structures for Structural Stiffness, Thermal Performance, and Dynamic Characteristics
full_list.abstract: This study presents a multi-objective topology optimization framework for lightweight thermo-mechanical structures subjected to simultaneous mechanical, thermal, and dynamic requirements. A two-dimensional simply supported structure is modeled using a structured quadrilateral finite element mesh comprising 4,800 Q4 elements and 4,961 nodes. The material distribution is parameterized using the Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization (SIMP) approach with a penalization factor of 3.0 and a prescribed volume fraction of 40%. Three coupled performance criteria are considered: structural compliance, total heat transfer, and fundamental natural frequency. Thermal, structural, and modal finite element analyses are sequentially performed for each candidate topology within a multi-objective evolutionary optimization procedure. The optimized configuration preserves the prescribed material volume and total mass of 31.20 kg while redistributing material toward mechanically and dynamically efficient regions. The results show a reduction in structural compliance from 8.70646×10− 2 to 8.65559×10− 2, corresponding to a 0.584% improvement. The fundamental natural frequency increases from 145.63 to 148.24 Hz, representing a 1.793% improvement, while the second and third natural frequencies reach 295.03 and 555.69 Hz, respectively. Total heat transfer changes only marginally from 43.2021 to 43.2368 W, corresponding to a 0.0804% increase. The final optimized structure exhibits a maximum displacement of 4.6663×10− 4 m, maximum von Mises stress of 1.0372×105 Pa, mean von Mises stress of 1.3848×104 Pa, and maximum heat flux of 421.08 W/m². The results demonstrate that coupled topology optimization can improve structural stiffness and dynamic performance while maintaining a fixed material budget and nearly unchanged thermal behavior. The proposed framework provides a computationally efficient basis for the design of lightweight structures requiring simultaneous mechanical, thermal, and vibration performance.

full_list.title_en: Path Planning of Surgical Robot for Minimally Invasive Surgery on Riemannian Manifold
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Path Planning of Surgical Robot for Minimally Invasive Surgery on Riemannian Manifold
full_list.abstract: Robotic surgery for minimally invasive surgery can reduce the surgeon’s workload by autonomously guiding robotic forceps. Movement of the robot is restricted around a fixed insertion port. The robot often encounters angle limitations during operation. Also, the surface of the abdominal cavity is non-concave, making it computationally expensive to find the desired path. In this work, to solve these problems, we propose a method for path planning in joint space by transforming the position into a Riemannian manifold. An edge cost function is defined to search for a desired path in the joint space and reduce the range of motion of the joints. We found that the organ is mostly non-concave, making it easy to find the optimal path using gradient descent method. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method reduces the range of joint angle movement compared to calculations in position space.

full_list.title_en: Residual-Guided Adaptive Pressure Bases for Dimension-Reduced FLIP Projection
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Residual-Guided Adaptive Pressure Bases for Dimension-Reduced FLIP Projection
full_list.abstract: We present a residual-guided adaptive pressure basis for dimension-reduced FLIP liquid simulation. Uniform dimension reduction lowers the cost of the pressure Poisson solve, but aggressive coarsening can under-represent localized pressure variation near impacts, thin sheets, and complex free surfaces. Our method augments the coarse surface-aware pressure basis only in regions predicted to require additional representation capacity. The selection criterion combines the fine-grid residual of the reduced pressure solution with free-surface curvature and local velocity variation. To avoid a same-frame refinement re-solve, the filtered residual from the previous time step is used as a temporal predictor, while the geometric and kinematic indicators respond to newly formed structures. The resulting adaptive system requires a single reduced pressure solve per time step. Comparisons with uniform dimension reduction and full-resolution projection show lower pressure approximation error and post-projection divergence than uniform reduction with only a modest increase in pressure degrees of freedom and computation time. The same formulation is evaluated in both 2D and 3D FLIP simulations.

full_list.title_en: Root Class-Specific Phosphorus Dynamics and Antioxidant Defense Responses in Contrasting Chinese Fir Clones Under Phosphorus Deficiency
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Root Class-Specific Phosphorus Dynamics and Antioxidant Defense Responses in Contrasting Chinese Fir Clones Under Phosphorus Deficiency
full_list.abstract: Aims Phosphorus (P) deficiency is a serious constraint on the productivity of forest plantations, especially in Chinese fir (Cunninghamia lanceolata). This study aims to determine how P availability affects root class-specific P acquisition, antioxidant responses, and physiological adaptations in two contrasting Chinese fir clones (020 and 061) across three harvesting periods. Methods Seedlings were grown in P-deficient (P0) and P-replete (P1) conditions, and P dynamics and antioxidant responses were determined across root orders, shoots, and needles. Results Generally, P concentration and accumulation increased with harvesting time and were significantly higher in P-replete conditions, with clone-061 being the better P acquirer than clone-020. P concentration and accumulation differed significantly among root classes, indicating functional specialization in P acquisition and distribution. P uptake and translocation were highest during early harvestings, while P use efficiency was higher at later growth stages. Under P deficiency, the activities of antioxidant enzymes, such as superoxide dismutase, peroxidase, and catalase, increased with harvesting time, especially in clone-061, and the malondialdehyde content decreased with harvesting time and remained comparatively lower in clone-061, indicating reduced oxidative damage. According to principal component analysis, both P acquisition and antioxidant enzyme activity were positively associated with antioxidant responses and negatively associated with malondialdehyde in a distinct, root-class-specific manner. Conclusions Overall, clone-061 exhibited superior P acquisition, utilization efficiency, and antioxidant capacity, highlighting its greater adaptation to phosphorus-limited environments. These findings reveal root-specific P-use strategies and support selecting P-efficient Chinese fir genotypes for sustainable plantation management.

full_list.title_en: Runoff Interception Characteristics of a Y-Shaped Bamboo Structure for Slope Protection
full_list.title_zh: Y形竹护坡结构径流截流特性
full_list.abstract: Conventional slope protection systems are susceptible to runoff-induced erosion, surface-soil loss, and shallow soil deformation under rainfall conditions. This study developed a Y-shaped bamboo structure integrating runoff interception and seepage drainage functions. Model tests and theoretical analysis were conducted to investigate the runoff interception efficiency of the structure under simulated rainfall conditions. The results showed that the Y-shaped bamboo structure exhibited effective runoff interception performance, with the cumulative intercepted runoff increasing approximately linearly with rainfall duration. The included angle between the two wings had the greatest effect on runoff interception efficiency, followed by wing length and wing diameter, with these three parameters collectively accounting for 93.04% of the total variance. Furthermore, a theoretical runoff interception model coupling weir flow theory with Darcy's law was developed and validated against laboratory model tests, showing good agreement with the experimental results. The findings provide a theoretical basis for geometric optimization and support the potential application of Y-shaped bamboo structures in ecological slope protection.
full_list.abstract_zh: 传统的边坡保护系统在降雨条件下容易受到径流引起的侵蚀、地表土壤流失和浅层土壤变形的影响。本研究开发了一种集径流截流和渗流排水功能于一体的Y形竹结构。进行了模型试验和理论分析，以研究结构在模拟降雨条件下的径流截流效率。结果表明， Y形竹结构表现出有效的径流截流性能，累积截流量随降雨持续时间近似线性增加。两翼夹角对径流截流效率影响最大，其次是翅膀长度和翅膀直径，这三个参数合计占总方差的93.04%。

full_list.title_en: Self-Calibrated Hyperspectral Neural Radiance Fields for 3D Reconstruction of Bone and Bone Analogues
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Self-Calibrated Hyperspectral Neural Radiance Fields for 3D Reconstruction of Bone and Bone Analogues
full_list.abstract: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) captures rich, wavelength-dependent information linked to mineralised tissue composition, while3D reconstruction preserves surface morphology and structural detail. Combining the two offers a powerful, non-contactapproach for bone assessment, yet existing hyperspectral 3D reconstruction methods rely on externally estimated cameraposes (e.g., via COLMAP), an assumption that is often unreliable on bone surfaces due to their low texture, specular reflectance,and irregular morphology. To address this challenge, we propose BoNeRF-HS, a self-calibrated hyperspectral neural radiancefield for 3D reconstruction. BoNeRF-HS jointly optimises camera intrinsics, volume density, and hyperspectral radiance directlyfrom multi-view HSI, removing the need for COLMAP based poses. To exploit the correlation between neighbouring spectralbands, we introduce a gated spectral adapter head that learns a controlled, wavelength-dependent residual correction to thepredicted radiance. We evaluate BoNeRF-HS on a newly acquired multi-view hyperspectral dataset (45 views, 120 spectralbands, 400–1000 nm) of mouse bone, trabecular bone analogue, and cortical bone analogue specimens. Experimental resultsdemonstrate that our framework achieves improved reconstruction quality, and better preservation of bone surface detailscompared with existing approaches. These results establish a practical path toward pose-free, non-contact 3D hyperspectralcharacterisation of bone, with potential applications in intraoperative visualisation, forensic skeletal analysis, and biomaterialevaluation.

full_list.title_en: Synergistic Thermo-Hydrodynamic Enhancement in Ternary Hybrid Nanofluids (THN) Stabilized in Ethylene Glycol– Distilled Water Mixture (EG@DW 50:50)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Synergistic Thermo-Hydrodynamic Enhancement in Ternary Hybrid Nanofluids (THN) Stabilized in Ethylene Glycol– Distilled Water Mixture (EG@DW 50:50)
full_list.abstract: The synthesis of homogeneous and well dispersed mixed metal oxide (MMO) in a mixture of Ethylene Glycol and Distilled Water (EG@DW, 50:50) mixture is established using 2-Step probe sonication, ZnO, Al2O3, and TiO2 as an MMO/EG@DW based ternary hybrid nanofluids (THN) were prepared to evaluate the thermophysical, hydrodynamic and convective heat transfer coefficient (CHTC) characteristics in a closed straight stainless steel based circular geometry heat exchanger subjected to a constant heat flux of 10092.41 W m-2. All the metal oxides with different sizes and morphologies were taken at an equal 33.3 % weight and dispersed in EG@DW base fluid at four varying concentrations: 0.025 wt.%, 0.05 wt.%, 0.075 wt.% and 0.1 wt.% to attain well-dispersed hybrid nanofluids. The FESEM, UV-vis, and wt.% absorbance characterizations were carried out to see the uniform dispersion of all particles. The dynamic/kinematic viscosities, density, and thermal conductivity were evaluated at varying temperatures from 20ºC to 45ºC and varying wt.% concentrations. A significant improvement in all parameters was noticed when all metal oxides were loaded together in the EG@DW base fluid. The photograph sedimentation test was employed to assess the longer-term stability and suspension of all particles, and the results revealed surprising stability up to 7 weeks after preparation. Following the confirmation of the experimental analytical correlation, different test runs for MMO/EG@DW-based THN were conducted through a circular geometry heat exchanger in turbulent regions. A prominent enhancement in CHTC and Nusselt numbers was recorded on average and locally against varying Reynolds (Re) numbers from 5849 to 24544. The 0.1 wt.% concentration contributed a higher enhancement of 3120 W m−2 K−1 in CHTC of the MMO/EG@DW based THN with a slight increase in applied pumping power, which is due to the use of EG with DW. Further, the study stated that all the positive parameters at all Reynolds ranges and wt.% concentrations of MMO/EG@DW based THN offered the possible use of mixed metal oxides hybrid/composite aqueous suspension, together as an alternative working liquid in varying thermal management systems.

full_list.title_en: Tactile alert placement in driving contexts based on neurocognitive evidence and eight consensus based design guidelines
full_list.title_zh: 基于神经认知证据和八项基于共识的设计准则，在驾驶环境中放置触觉警报
full_list.abstract: Tactile alerts can communicate spatial and temporal information in automo-tive human–machine interfaces while reducing reliance on visual and auditory channels. Evidence on appropriate body locations for such alerts remains dis-tributed across automotive human-machine interface (HMI), haptic-interface, and somatosensory research. This study examines how body location may influ-ence the perception and processing of tactile alerts in driving contexts. It adopts a sequential evidence-to-consensus design comprising a scoping review of automo-tive HMI studies, reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR; an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses on tactile perception and processing; and a modified Delphi study with six specialists from automotive industry, design, and neuroscience. The scoping review identified fifteen eligible studies, while the umbrella review synthesized evidence from six eligible reviews. The integrated evidence indicates that body regions differ in tactile acuity and sensitivity and that spatial congruence between stimulation location and event direction may support alert interpretation and response. Ten preliminary design guidelines were formulated and subsequently evaluated and refined through expert consensus, resulting in eight consensus-supported guidelines.
full_list.abstract_zh: 触觉警报可以在自动人机界面中传达空间和时间信息，同时减少对视觉和听觉通道的依赖。在汽车人机界面（ HMI ）、触觉界面和躯体感觉研究中，有关此类警报的适当身体位置的证据仍然存在。本研究研究了身体位置如何影响驾驶环境中触觉警报的感知和处理。它采用循序的证据到共识设计，包括根据PRISMA-ScR报告的自动人机界面研究的范围审查；关于触觉感知和处理的系统评价和荟萃分析的总括审查；以及由来自汽车行业、设计和神经科学的六位专家参与的经修改的Delphi研究。

full_list.title_en: Temporally Coherent Hierarchical Distance Queries for Deformable Triangle Meshes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Temporally Coherent Hierarchical Distance Queries for Deformable Triangle Meshes
full_list.abstract: Signed-distance queries on deformable triangle meshes are fundamental operations that are repeatedly performed in a wide range of applications, including collision handling, surface tracking, physically based simulation, and geometric processing. However, in dynamic environments where a mesh continuously deforms over time, reconstructing a static hierarchy at every frame or updating all bounding volumes can incur substantial computational cost, while conventional distance-query acceleration structures do not fully exploit such temporal coherence. In this paper, we propose a temporally coherent hierarchical distance-query method for deformable triangle meshes. The proposed method maintains an anisotropic temporal bound for each hierarchy node to account for local deformation and selectively refreshes the stored reference bound only for nodes whose deformation magnitude exceeds a prescribed threshold, thereby preserving the tightness of the temporal bounds. In addition, nearest-triangle information from the previous frame is retained as a compact persistent seed and re-evaluated on the deformed geometry of the current frame to obtain a tight initial distance upper bound. A stackless traversal is then performed using conservatively expanded hierarchical bounds to compute the exact nearest triangle and signed distance. This temporal-coherence-based hierarchy reuse and selective refresh strategy effectively reduces the cost of repeated distance queries while preserving accuracy under continuous mesh deformation. Experimental results show that, under identical distance-field resolutions and deformation conditions, the proposed method produces signed-distance values that agree with those of the baseline within numerical precision while improving distance-query performance by up to approximately 2.5× in the evaluated tests. The proposed method can therefore be effectively applied to a broad range of real-time graphics and simulation applications that require repeated distance computations on dynamic and deformable geometry.

full_list.title_en: Topography shapes the internal organisation of tiger home ranges in the plateau-gorge landscapes of central India
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topography shapes the internal organisation of tiger home ranges in the plateau-gorge landscapes of central India
full_list.abstract: Accurate home-range estimation is central to understanding animal space use, yet most telemetry studies represent terrestrial movement on two-dimensional planimetric surfaces and may therefore overlook the effects of terrain. Although digital elevation model (DEM)-based three-dimensional correction can improve home-range estimates in steep mountainous environments, its ecological relevance in plateau-gorge landscapes remain unclear. We examined how topography influences both home-range estimation and the internal organisation of space use by resident tigers (Panthera tigris) in the Vindhyan plateau-gorge landscape of central India. Using long-term GPS telemetry data, we compared two-dimensional and DEM-corrected three-dimensional autocorrelated kernel density estimates for 50% core areas and 95% home ranges across sexes and seasons. We also classified the landscape into six functional landform classes using DEM-derived geomorphometric variables and applied a Bayesian Dirichlet core–shell model to quantify landform enrichment within 50% core areas relative to the surrounding 95 − 50% home-range shell. Topographic correction produced only negligible increases in estimated home-range area, with 3D-to-2D ratios close to unity, indicating that vertical relief contributed little to the geometric extent of tiger home ranges in this landscape. Terrain nevertheless strongly influenced where intensive space use occurred. Core areas were consistently enriched in rugged refuge and low-drainage landforms, whereas open plateau was systematically under-represented. These patterns were strongest during summer and monsoon and were more pronounced and seasonally consistent in females than in males, suggesting sex-specific differences in the spatial organisation of core use. By contrast, general slope showed little evidence of consistent enrichment across seasons. Our results show that a limited effect of topographic correction on total home-range area should not be interpreted as evidence that terrain is ecologically unimportant. In this plateau–gorge system, topography shaped the internal distribution of tiger space use more strongly than the outer geometry of the home range. Combining DEM-derived landform classification with Bayesian compositional analysis therefore reveals ecological structure that conventional home-range metrics alone may miss. This framework is broadly transferable to wide-ranging terrestrial mammals in heterogeneous landscapes and can help identify terrain features that contribute disproportionately to habitat quality and conservation value.

full_list.title_en: Yes, Trees are the Solution for Thermal Comfort and Environmental Quality in Equatorial Public Squares
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Yes, Trees are the Solution for Thermal Comfort and Environmental Quality in Equatorial Public Squares
full_list.abstract: Unregulated urban expansion can diminish green spaces and alter microclimatic conditions, thereby compromising thermal comfort and the quality of life for the population. In this context, urban forestry plays a pivotal role in mitigating warming effects within urban environments. The present study aimed to analyze the influence of urban tree canopy cover on surface temperature and thermal comfort in urban squares within the municipality of Santarém, Pará state, Brazil. To this end, in situ measurements of surface temperature were conducted using an infrared thermometer, alongside assessments of thermal stress and perceived temperature using a heat stress meter equipped with the Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT) index. Data were collected in both tree-shaded and unshaded areas across seven city squares at 08:00, 13:00, and 18:00. The results demonstrated that the afternoon period exhibited the highest mean values for surface temperature (40.1°C), thermal stress (31.6°C), and perceived temperature (48.3°C). Areas lacking tree canopy cover recorded higher surface temperatures (39.7°C), elevated thermal stress (30.5°C), and greater perceived temperatures (45.4°C) compared to tree-shaded areas. Among the evaluated sites, Liberdade Square presented the highest mean surface temperature (40.8°C), while São Raimundo and Três Poderes squares recorded the highest values for thermal stress (31.2°C) and perceived temperature (48.6°C). We conclude that the presence of tree canopy cover significantly contributes to lowering surface temperatures and improving thermal comfort conditions, thereby highlighting the critical role of urban forestry in urban planning and the enhancement of urban environmental quality.

full_list.title_en: Cerdà Revisited: Food Retail in Barcelona’s Eixample District. A Spatial Point Pattern Analysis.
full_list.title_zh: 重访 Cerdà：巴塞罗那扩展区的食品零售店。空间点模式分析。
full_list.abstract: The commemoration of the 150th anniversary of Ildefons Cerdà’s death during the Cerdà Year 2026, together with Barcelona’s designation as World Capital of Architecture 2026, provides a timely context in which to reassess the contemporary relevance of Cerdà’s urban principles. This study examines whether the spatial organisation of food retail in the Eixample district continues to reflect the proximity-based and territorially balanced provision envisaged in his plan. Using georeferenced data for seven food retail categories, we combine kernel intensity estimation, Clark–Evans statistics, inhomogeneous Ripley’s K-functions, entropy measures across Voronoi-based market catchments, and inhomogeneous Poisson point process models. The findings reveal two distinct spatial logics: most traditional food retailers exhibit significant clustering, whereas supermarkets follow a more spatially extensive distribution and do not differ significantly from complete spatial randomness. Population density is positively and significantly associated with the intensity of every retail category, confirming the importance of residential demand. Conversely, distance to municipal markets shows a weak and category-specific relationship, suggesting that the market network no longer constitutes the principal organising structure of food retail anticipated by Cerdà. Distance to Passeig de Gràcia has a consistently negative effect, although the density surfaces reveal a spatial displacement process. Market catchments remain functionally diverse, particularly around Sagrada Família and Ninot. Overall, the results show how Cerdà’s historical framework of proximity is being reconfigured by residential density, commercial centrality, and touristification, with implications for food accessibility, retail diversity, and spatially equitable planning in dense urban environments.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在 2026 年 Cerdà 期间纪念 Ildefons Cerdà 逝世 150 周年，以及巴塞罗那被指定为 2026 年世界建筑之都，为重新评估 Cerdà 城市原则的当代意义提供了一个及时的背景。本研究探讨了扩展区食品零售的空间组织是否继续反映其计划中设想的基于邻近性和地域平衡的供应。使用七个食品零售类别的地理参考数据，我们结合了核强度估计、Clark-Evans 统计、非齐次 Ripley 的 K 函数、基于 Voronoi 的市场流域的熵度量以及非齐次泊松点过程模型。研究结果揭示了两种不同的空间逻辑：大多数传统食品零售商表现出显着的集群性，而超市则遵循更广泛的空间分布，并且与完全的空间随机性没有显着差异。人口密度与每个零售类别的强度呈显着正相关，证实了住宅需求的重要性。相反，与市政市场的距离显示出较弱的特定类别关系，表明市场网络不再构成 Cerdà 预期的食品零售的主要组织结构。尽管密度表面揭示了空间位移过程，但到格拉西亚大道的距离始终具有负面影响。市场集水区在功能上仍然多样化，特别是在圣家堂和尼诺特周围。总体而言，结果显示了 Cerdà 的历史框架如何通过住宅密度、商业中心性和旅游化进行重新配置，从而对密集城市环境中的食品可及性、零售多样性和空间公平规划产生影响。

full_list.title_en: Development of a Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI): An Integrated Framework for Assessing Resilience, Circular Economy, and Long-Term Sustainability
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Development of a Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI): An Integrated Framework for Assessing Resilience, Circular Economy, and Long-Term Sustainability
full_list.abstract: Wastewater treatment plants are often assessed by compliance and cost, which leaves energy, carbon, resource recovery, asset condition, climate exposure and digital capability outside a single view. We reformulate the conceptual Water Infrastructure Sustainability Index (WISI) as a computable index for wastewater treatment plants. WISI v1.1 combines seven dimensions (technical performance, water, energy, circular economy, carbon, asset resilience, digital intelligence) through 22 normalised indicators and weighted arithmetic aggregation. The reformulation corrects inverted indicator directions, removes undefined and non-applicable indicators, and limits double counting by assigning each physical flow to one dimension. Because no complete operational dataset was available, we tested the index on 40 synthetic plants, with 50 replicate datasets, using Monte Carlo weight perturbation, varying weight distributions, and alternative model structures. Rankings were stable under moderate weight uncertainty (median Spearman ρ = 0.98 for Dirichlet κ = 50) and fell to 0.87 only when weights were nearly random (κ = 3); aggregation rule changed rankings most (ρ = 0.95 for geometric aggregation). Nominal weights did not match effective influence: technical performance, with the largest weight (0.20), accounted for about 7–8% of index variance. Class bands from the earlier framework placed a median of 70% of synthetic plants in the lowest class; data-derived bands were uncertain by about five score points. A feasibility check on two operating plants showed that routine laboratory data cover only 3 of the 22 indicators.

full_list.title_en: Observation-Based Initialization for Inverse Modeling of Atmospheric Temperature with Rossby-Constrained Transport
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Observation-Based Initialization for Inverse Modeling of Atmospheric Temperature with Rossby-Constrained Transport
full_list.abstract: We consider a finite-dimensional inverse problem for atmospheric temperature transport from sparse satellite observations. A spectral stream function with Rossby dispersion defines the horizontal velocity, and a convection--diffusion equation maps its parameters to temperature measurements. The main methodological component is a regularized construction of the initial temperature and compatible latitudinal boundary values from the preceding day's observations. A bounded latitude coordinate, a low-order background, and two longitudinal harmonics provide a smooth periodic initial field without using the assimilation day's temperatures. Continuous piecewise-linear finite elements, implicit Euler stepping, and streamline upwind/Petrov--Galerkin stabilization solve the forward problem. An adaptive artificial bee colony algorithm identifies 28 flow parameters under a shared perturbation-speed constraint. For 105 nighttime Aura Microwave Limb Sounder measurements on 6 March 2011, the fine-mesh root-mean-square discrepancy is 5.129 K and the Pearson correlation is 0.660. The corresponding linear-initialization experiment gives 6.127 K and 0.373, respectively. The root-mean-square discrepancy therefore decreases by 16.3%. A static evaluation of the new initial field gives a correlation of 0.549, providing a reference for assessing the additional improvement obtained with optimized transport. The results support observation-based initialization for temperature reconstruction within the considered model and motivate further evaluation of predictive performance and flow identifiability.
